items.title: Amodei: Anthropic ‘not super fussed’ with timing of IPO
items.summary: Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) CEO Dario Amodei sits down with JPMorgan Chase (JPM) CEO Jamie Dimon to discuss the timing of the company’s IPO and its guiding “underpromise and overdeliver” philosophy.

items.title: JPMorgan’s Top Credit Cards Executive Is Leaving the Bank
items.summary: Allison Beer, the CEO of card and connected commerce, “has informed me of her decision to leave the firm for an external opportunity,” JPMorgan Co-President Troy Rohrbaugh said in a memo on Friday.

items.title: Amodei Highlights Computing Power, Capex Dilemma Ahead Of Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Dario Amodei warns that managing massive computing power and infrastructure spending is the company's deepest business challenge, in a fireside chat with JPMorgan chief Jamie Dimon.

items.title: JPMorgan’s latest filing reveals a bigger Bitcoin footprint
items.summary: JPMorgan’s latest SEC filing shows growing positions in Bitcoin-linked stocks and funds, including a big jump in one company.

items.title: 4 Takeaways From Dario Amodei’s Anthropic IPO Chat With Jamie Dimon
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei makes the case for taking part in the company’s initial public offering in a chat with JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon.

items.title: JPMorgan’s Bitcoin and Crypto-Linked Holdings Approach $1 Billion
items.summary: The bank’s Q3 13F shows roughly $981 million across Bitcoin ETFs, Strategy and Coinbase—likely over $1 billion counting Robinhood and miners.

items.title: Anthropic Chief Says He Hopes IPO Will ‘Underpromise and Overdeliver’
items.summary: Anthropic Chief Executive Dario Amodei said that when it comes to the artificial-intelligence giant’s planned initial public offering, he hopes the company will “underpromise and overdeliver.”
